scene: You arrive at Candy Foundry by steam train.
picture: Flat side view. On the left sits the puffing brass steam train on tracks. Beside it, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair. A pink taffy crane pulls sweets on the far left. A glowing sugar furnace warms the centre, while a striped refinery door waits far right.
shown: a mechanical taffy puller stretching pink candy on the far left
a glowing brick sugar furnace with open iron grate at the centre
a striped doorway leading into the caramel refinery on the far right

variants.scene: Sweet steam fills the station air as your train pulls up to the platform.
You arrive at the bustling factory, still humming {tune} as workers gather nearby.
The great brick oven glows warmly as sweet smells drift across the stone platform.
